candidates.name: money-as-integer-cents
candidates.summary: Monetary amounts must be stored and processed as integer cents, never floats.
candidates.readWhen: Any change touching money.ts or code that creates, parses, sums, or serializes monetary amounts.
candidates.text:
- All monetary amounts **must** be represented as integer cents.
- "Never use floats for money" — floating-point representation introduces rounding/precision errors in financial calculations.
- If violated: amounts can silently drift (e.g. $0.1 + $0.2 rounding errors), causing incorrect balances, charges, or totals.
